item.tib: tshe dbang yang zhun gyi dbang khrid
item.coloph: ces gsung nas g.yung drung rgyal po la gtad do/ de nas rig 'dzin rim gyis brgyud nas/ dran pa ye shes nyid la gtad/ mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma dang dran pa ye shes gnyis kyi/ (kyis) bon dar nub dus su/ bon sde 'di la rgyas bsdus gnyis su phyes/ rgyas pa dran pa ye shes kyi phyag tu bsnams/ 'bring po rma ri pom rar gter du sbas/ dus mthar dar ba'i smon lam btab/ ye shes mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma'i (mas/)las ldan skyes bu bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ bka' skyongs srung mas dbyings nas mi bskyon pa/ rjes 'jug nyes pa'i bdud las rab rgyal nas/ bla med rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu myur thob shog sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
